summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by First Eagle Private Credit Fund reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including the election of trustees and ratification of the independent auditor. It also provides Regulation FD disclosure of regular monthly distributions and an updated net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is present. The filing is purely operational and informational in nature.
